summary: Inspected all 4 files in the work unit. Groebner/Groebner.lean (54KB) defines the IsGroebnerBasis predicate and proves 50+ theorems including Buchberger criterion, existence/uniqueness of remainders, and ideal membership characterizations. Groebner/Ideal.lean (16KB) provides 15+ lemmas about minimal elements in preorders, ideal spans of monomial images, and membership criteria for ideal spans in monoid/polynomial algebras. Groebner/MonomialOrderEmbedding.lean (10KB) defines the Embedding structure for monomial orders with 20+ lemmas proving preservation of degree, leading coefficients/terms, and s-polynomials under embeddings. Groebner/WeakRemainder.lean (15KB) formalizes the weak division algorithm with 10+ lemmas about colex order, support properties, and termination. All four files contain substantial formal mathematical definitions, statements, and proofs central to Gröbner basis theory.
